title: Mujh Se Pehli Si Mohabbat
author: Faiz Ahmed Faiz
who: Faiz Ahmed Faiz (1911 to 1984) was one of the best known Urdu poets of the twentieth century, born in Punjab in British India and later a citizen of Pakistan. He was associated with the Progressive Writers' Movement.
why: The poem appears in his first collection, Naqsh-e-Faryadi, published in 1941. It is widely read as the point where his poetry turns from love alone toward the suffering of the world around him. A famous sung version is by Noor Jehan.
notice: Notice that it is a love poem that asks the beloved not to expect the old kind of love. Watch for the moment the speaker's eyes move from one person to everyone else. Ask yourself whether the love has grown smaller or larger by the end.
prompts: Has something in the wider world ever changed how you love one person?
What did love mean to you ten years ago that it no longer means?
